name: Clos Saint-Denis
rightsHistoryPurpose: Official filiation, dated legal-entity rights and original-reference evidence for Clos Saint-Denis (#461). None establishes current farming.

reviewedUncoveredArea.note: The measured 197.649623 m² remainder (0.2984%) was reviewed against the pinned INAO boundary and Chambolle-Musigny and Morey-Saint-Denis cadastres. The cru outline has three separate parts; the remainder is narrow strips along their edges and between parcels. It forms 15 pieces, with mean widths of 0.19–1.28 m for those of at least 1 m². 13.663154 m² lies between parcels inside the outline and the rest along its edge. It is not a missing INAO commune. 197.649623 m² is covered by no audited parcel. No geometry is added, clipped, buffered or filled. The absolute cap allows less than 0.1 m² above this reviewed measurement; changed source hashes require another review.

namedPlots.coverageNote: Calouère, Clos Saint-Denis, Les Chaffots and Maison Brûlée are cadastral named areas within Clos Saint-Denis; only part of the cadastral Les Chaffots lies inside the cru. Outlines follow the cadastre inside the official boundary, with small gaps retained; they do not show producer holdings. A label naming only the cru keeps the whole-cru outline.

reviewedOverlaps.note: The pinned cadastral lieux-dits CALOUERE and MAISON BRULEE overlap by 10.205 m² inside the cru. Both outlines are kept exactly as published; neither is clipped to resolve it, and the overlap does not assign a parcel to both.

neighbouringLieuxDits.reason: Not an official Clos Saint-Denis climat. It holds most of a parcel that only touches the cru edge; it stays a cru parcel for rights and history, with no named area.
